title: 第11章 半决赛对战——内门15年拳师
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
半决赛当天，演武场比前一天更挤。

    看台上加了三排座位，连过道里都站满了人。

    林尘到的时候，玉玲珑已经在场边等着了。

    她穿着一身浅青色长裙，头发盘得比平时低了一点，看见林尘过来，微微点了下头。

    “昨晚休息得怎么样。”

    “还行。打坐了两个时辰，把师尊昨天给的功法又练了几遍。”

    “那套瞬身步是玄阶上品身法，为师当年在外游历时偶然所得。本想自己用，但突破元婴之后这种筑基期的身法就派不上用场了。正好你现在缺一门逃命的本事，短距离瞬移，消耗灵力少，练熟了连续用十几次不带喘。本来打算是给你留着用作决赛底牌，混沌圣体确实能给你增加胜算，但如果…”

    “师尊放心，我都懂”

    玉玲珑看了他一眼，没再多说，转身往看台上走。

    林尘走上擂台的时候，对手已经在等他了。

    孟彦看上去二十七八岁，身材中等，肩膀很宽，手掌比常人大了一圈，指节粗大，虎口和拳峰上全是厚厚的老茧。

    那是长年累月打木桩打出来的。

    筑基巅峰的修为毫不掩饰地外放着，气势沉凝，跟刘峰那种张扬的压迫感完全不同。

    “林尘。”

    孟彦主动拱手，声音很稳。

    “内门弟子孟彦，筑基巅峰。之前看了你跟刘峰的比试——你，确实很强。但我修炼了十五年拳功，自认实力在同级弟子中不算弱。所以，今天我会全力打你，若有冒犯，还请…”

    林尘拱了拱手。

    “林尘，筑基初期。晚辈定当全力以赴，请师兄赐教。”

    裁判挥下旗子。

    孟彦毕竟是老手，没有像刘峰那样一上来就抢攻。

    他往前迈了一步，步法沉稳，脚尖落地无声，双拳一前一后护在胸前。

    这是混元拳的起手式——攻守兼备。

    第一拳试探性地朝林尘肩膀打过来，力道只用了五成，拳路中正平和，但后招已经蓄好了。

    林尘侧身避开，没有急着还手。

    果然，第一拳刚被躲开，孟彦的第二拳紧跟着就到了，力道加到了七成，拳风擦着林尘的衣角过去，带起一阵低沉的破风声。

    孟彦的拳法确实扎实，一招一式有板有眼，没有花里胡哨的虚招。

    混元拳在他手上使出来，拳势连绵不绝，前拳未尽后拳已到，擂台上拳影重重。

    林尘在拳影中闪避了七八招，终于逮到一个空隙，抬手一掌朝孟彦胸口拍过去。

    孟彦反应极快，没有硬接，双拳交叉格挡的同时身体往后撤了半步，筑基巅峰的灵力在手臂上形成一层淡金色的护体灵光。

    掌拳相撞，砰的一声闷响在擂台上炸开。

    孟彦后退了两步，手臂上的护体灵光被震散了，但人稳稳站住了。

    林尘自己也被反震之力推得后退了一步，脚底在石板上擦出一道白痕。

    “果然跟韩铁说的一样。你的掌力很沉，不像筑基初期。”孟彦甩了甩发麻的手臂，“不过你境界终究差我一截。刚才那掌，你自己也被震退了吧。”

    林尘没说话，甩了甩发麻的手掌。筑基巅峰的底蕴确实不是刘峰能比的。

    孟彦不再试探了。

    双拳上灵光暴涨，混元拳的精髓全数展开。

    左拳虚晃，右拳直捣林尘面门，拳风呼呼作响。

    林尘侧身避开直拳，孟彦的左拳已经跟上来封住了退路。

    这两拳衔接得天衣无缝，林尘避无可避，抬手格挡。

    拳头砸在他小臂上，筑基巅峰的全力一击透过护体灵力传来，整条手臂都麻了。

    他还没来得及调整，孟彦的下一拳又到了。

    混元拳的厉害之处就在于连绵不绝，一拳接一拳，不给对手喘息的机会。

    孟彦的双拳像两口大锤，轮番朝林尘砸过来，每一拳都带着筑基巅峰的浑厚灵力。

    林尘用双掌格挡，拳掌相撞的闷响声在擂台上炸个不停。

    擂台上的灰尘被气浪震得四散飞扬，看台上的弟子们看得大气都不敢出。

    挡了十几掌之后，林尘的小臂已经疼得发胀，虎口被震得裂开，鲜血顺着手指往下滴。

    孟彦的拳势没有半点衰减，反而越打越猛。

    又是一拳正面轰来，林尘双臂交叉格挡，被直接震退了四五步，脚后跟踩在擂台边缘才勉强停住。

    胸口一阵气血翻涌，喉咙里涌上一股腥甜，他硬生生咽了回去。

    还没等他站稳，孟彦的下一拳已经追到了。

    这一拳结结实实地砸在他胸口，护体灵力被轰得寸寸碎裂，肋骨传来一阵剧痛。

    林尘闷哼一声，整个人被打得倒飞出去，后背撞在擂台石柱上，摔落在地，一口血咳了出来。

    看台上一阵惊呼。

    玉玲珑的手指猛地收紧，攥皱了膝上的裙摆，指节发白。

    她没有站起来，但掌门注意到她肩头微微绷了一下。

    “林尘！”

    “他咳血了！孟师兄这一拳太重了！”

    “筑基初期果然打不过筑基巅峰！之前打刘峰是运气吧？孟师兄的混元拳根本没破绽！”

    孟彦没有追击，站在原地调整呼吸，他的消耗也不小。

    “你确实很强。筑基初期能正面接我这么多拳，苍梧宗找不出第二个。”

    他顿了顿。

    “但你的内脏已经震伤了，肋骨应该也裂了，再打下去对你不公平。认输吧。”
content_en:
On the day of the semi-finals, the martial arts arena was more crowded than the day before.
Three rows of seats were added to the stands, and even the aisles were filled with people.
When Lin Chen arrived, Yu Linglong was already waiting on the sidelines.
She was wearing a light cyan dress and her hair was tied a little lower than usual. When she saw Lin Chen coming over, she nodded slightly.
"How was your rest last night?"
"It's not bad. I meditated for two hours and practiced the exercises that Master gave me yesterday several times."
"That set of teleportation steps is a high-grade Xuan-level movement technique. It was accidentally acquired by the teacher when he was traveling abroad. I wanted to use it myself, but after breaking through the Nascent Soul, this kind of foundation-building movement technique is no longer useful. It just so happens that you lack the ability to escape now. Short-distance teleportation consumes less spiritual power. Once you are familiar with it, you can use it more than ten times in a row without losing breath. The original plan was to keep it for you to use as a trump card in the finals. The Chaos Holy Body can indeed increase your chances of winning, but if..."
"Master, don't worry, I understand everything."
Yu Linglong glanced at him, said nothing more, turned around and walked towards the stands.
When Lin Chen walked onto the ring, his opponent was already waiting for him.
Meng Yan looked to be in his mid-twenties, with a medium build, broad shoulders, his hands were a bit larger than ordinary people, his knuckles were thick, and his mouth and fists were covered with thick calluses.
It was made by driving wooden piles over many years.
The cultivation level at the peak of Foundation Establishment was displayed unabashedly, with a calm aura, which was completely different from Liu Feng's flamboyant sense of oppression.
"Lin Chen."
Meng Yan took the initiative to offer his hand, his voice steady.
"Inner disciple Meng Yan is at the peak of foundation building. I saw you compete with Liu Feng before - you are indeed very strong. But I have been practicing boxing for fifteen years, and I consider myself to be not weak among disciples of the same level. Therefore, today I will beat you with all my strength. If you are offended, please..."
Lin Chen cupped his hands.
"Lin Chen, we are in the early stages of foundation building. The younger generation must go all out and ask senior brother for advice."
The referee waved the flag.
After all, Meng Yan was a veteran and did not rush to attack like Liu Feng did.
He took a step forward, his steps were steady, his toes landed silently, and his fists were placed in front of his chest one after another.
This is the starting position of Hunyuan Quan - both offensive and defensive.
The first punch was tentatively thrown at Lin Chen's shoulder, with only 50% of the force used. The punch was gentle, but the back move was already prepared.
Lin Chen stepped aside and did not rush to fight back.
Sure enough, as soon as the first punch was dodged, Meng Yan's second punch followed, with 70% strength. The wind of the punch brushed against the corner of Lin Chen's clothes, causing a low sound of breaking wind.
Meng Yan's boxing skills are indeed solid, every move is precise and precise, and there are no flashy feints.
Hunyuan Fist was used in his hands, and the punches were continuous. Before the front punch was finished, the back punch was already coming, and there were many shadows of the fists on the ring.
Lin Chen dodged seven or eight moves in the shadow of the fist, and finally found an opening, raised his hand and slapped Meng Yan on the chest.
Meng Yan reacted very quickly and did not make a hard connection. He crossed his fists to block and at the same time took a half step back. The spiritual power at the peak of Foundation Establishment formed a layer of pale golden body-protecting aura on his arms.
Palms and fists collided, and a muffled bang exploded in the ring.
Meng Yan took two steps back. The protective aura on his arm was shaken away, but he stood firm.
Lin Chen himself was pushed back a step by the force of the backlash, and the soles of his feet scratched a white mark on the stone slab.
"It's exactly what Han Tie said. Your palm force is very heavy, unlike in the early stage of foundation establishment." Meng Yan shook his numb arm, "But after all, your realm is not as good as mine. You must have been repelled by that palm just now."
Lin Chen said nothing and shook his numb palms.The foundation of the peak foundation building is indeed not comparable to that of Liu Feng.
Meng Yan stopped testing.
The spiritual light on both fists surged, and all the essence of Hunyuan Fist was unfolded.
The left fist feinted, and the right fist hit Lin Chen's face, making a whistling sound.
Lin Chen turned sideways to avoid the straight punch, but Meng Yan's left fist had already followed up to block the retreat.
The two punches connected so seamlessly that Lin Chen couldn't avoid it and raised his hands to block.
The fist hit his forearm, and the full force of the attack at the peak of Foundation Establishment was transmitted through the protective spiritual power, and the whole arm was numb.
Before he could adjust, Meng Yan's next punch came again.
The great thing about Hunyuan Quan is that it is continuous, punch after punch, without giving the opponent a chance to breathe.
Meng Yan's fists were like two sledgehammers, hitting Lin Chen in turn, each punch carrying the powerful spiritual power of the peak of foundation building.
Lin Chen blocked with both palms, and the muffled sound of fists clashing echoed in the ring.
The dust on the ring was blown away by the air waves, and the disciples in the stands were so shocked that they didn't dare to express their anger.
After blocking more than a dozen palms, Lin Chen's forearm was already swollen with pain, his mouth was split open by the shock, and blood was dripping down his fingers.
Meng Yan's fist power did not weaken at all, but became stronger and stronger.
Another punch came from the front. Lin Chen crossed his arms to block, but was knocked back four or five steps. He barely stopped when he stepped on the edge of the ring with his heels.
Qi and blood surged in his chest, and a fishy-sweet taste surged in his throat. He swallowed it hard.
Before he could stand firm, Meng Yan's next punch had already caught up with him.
This punch hit his chest firmly, and the protective spiritual force was shattered inch by inch, causing a sharp pain in his ribs.
Lin Chen groaned and was knocked backwards. His back hit the stone pillar of the arena and fell to the ground. He coughed out a mouthful of blood.
There was a burst of exclamation in the stands.
Yu Linglong's fingers suddenly tightened and she wrinkled the skirt on her knees, her knuckles turned white.
She did not stand up, but the leader noticed that her shoulders were slightly tense.
"Lin Chen!"
"He coughed up blood! Senior Brother Meng's punch was too hard!"
"Sure enough, I can't beat the peak of Foundation Establishment at the early stage of Foundation Establishment! Is it luck to beat Liu Feng before? Senior Brother Meng's Hunyuan Fist has no flaws at all!"
Meng Yan did not pursue, but stood there to adjust his breathing. He had consumed a lot of energy.
"You are indeed very strong. In the early stage of foundation building, you can receive so many punches from me head-on. Cangwu Sect cannot find anyone else."
He paused.
"But your internal organs are already damaged by the shock, and your ribs should be cracked. It wouldn't be fair for you to be beaten any longer. Just admit defeat."
title_en: Chapter 11 Semi-final battle - a 15-year inner sect boxer
